description_en: Queries the monitoring data of a specified cloud service instance within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询一段时间内指定产品实例的监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms query-metric-list --callby-cms-owner 97u8ers --project acs_ecs_dashboard --metric cpu_idle --period 60 --start-time 2019-01-30_00:00:00 --end-time 2019-01-30_00:10:00 --dimensions instanceId:_rm-zf86h352r1ljuqp4r --page 1 --cursor v2. --length 1000 --express groupby_:_instanceId --api-version 2016-09-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMetricList

parameters.help_en: The project of the metric. Used to query monitoring data
parameters.help_zh: 监控项的project，用于查询监控数据
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The time interval of the metric. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 监控项的时间间隔。单位：秒
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The start time for querying the metric.

Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (for example, 2019-01-31 10:00:00). The default time zone is UTC+8
parameters.help_zh:
查询监控项的开始时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss（例如 2019-01-31 10:00:00），时区默认为 UTC+8（北京时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time for querying the metric.

Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (for example, 2019-01-31 10:10:00). The default time zone is UTC+8
parameters.help_zh:
查询监控项的结束时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss（例如 2019-01-31 10:10:00），时区默认为 UTC+8（北京时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring dimensions of the specified resource.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs, for example, `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` and `{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`.

A maximum of 50 instances can be queried in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
指定资源的监控维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：`{"userId":"120886317861****"}`和`{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`。

单次请求最多支持批量查询50个实例
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en: The cursor for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 下一页数据，为空代表没有下一页
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.help_en: The number of records displayed on each page
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en: The expression for real-time computation on existing query results, for example, `{"groupby":["instanceId"]}`
parameters.help_zh: 对查询出的现有结果进行时时计算的表达式，例如` {"groupby":["instanceId"]}`
parameters.name: express

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

Cursor.description_en: The cursor for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
Cursor.description_zh: 下一页数据，为空代表没有下一页

Datapoints.description_en: The list of monitoring data. Content format example: {"timestamp":1490164200000,"maximum":100,"userid":"1234567898765432","minimum":4.55,"instanceid":"i-bp18abl200xk9599ck7c","average":93.84}
Datapoints.description_zh: 监控数据列表，内容格式例如：{"timestamp":1490164200000,"maximum":100,"userid":"1234567898765432","minimum":4.55,"instanceid":"i-bp18abl200xk9599ck7c","average":93.84}

Period.description_en: The time interval of the metric. Unit: seconds
Period.description_zh: 监控项的时间间隔。单位：秒

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
